title: Test-only explicit UserDemand apply seam for a coupler-owned 6-hour management clock

sequencing.rationale: Freeze the proposed solve/apply separation before observing the fine-saveat conflict result.

purpose: Test whether the DUMMY-19I failure is resolved by an explicit allocation-application seam, without coupling application to output recording. This is a test-only counterfactual contract experiment, not a production Ribasim modification.

test_only_apply_contract.at_each_6h_boundary: Solve allocation from the accepted current physical state with record=false, then copy only the optimized UserDemand allocations and per-link optimized inflows into the corresponding applied UserDemand state arrays before advancing the next physical segment.
explicitly_not_done: no allocation output record is created by the apply helper

hypotheses: An explicit solve→apply seam at each accepted 6-hour boundary is sufficient to make the physical UserDemand target follow the 6-hour allocation trajectory while solver.saveat remains daily.
No allocation output recording is required for the physical apply operation itself.
Physical recipient volumes and Basin endpoint match the frozen 6-hour reference within tolerance.
This demonstrates the coupling-contract capability that DUMMY-19I lacked: allocation application/commit can be conceptually separated from allocation output recording.
forbidden: no source modification to pinned Ribasim
no claim that the test helper is a production API
no changing frozen 6-hour references after execution
no applying Pump/Outlet conclusions to UserDemand or vice versa

authority_rebind.meaning: Executable explicit-apply experiment rebound after 19J closeout; frozen model, 6-hour references and tolerances are unchanged.
